test_title: PYST 42: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only one person sits to the right of E. Only three people sit between G and E. Only three people sit between A and D, none of whom sits on the left end. F sits to the immediate right of C. Only one person sits between A and B. Who sits second to the left of C?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north.

1. Only one person sits to the right of E.

2. Only three people sit between G and E.

3. Only three people sit between A and D, none of whom sits on the left end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e6621fbd84c38a43d47406081a83cb9a0f22b20695e7f56208d6974558032e0.png] 

4. F sits to the immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a854cbe8f2c1d95348e6a99f283c0701d72e8a5c2b08b98d841dc3c63673438.png] 

5. Only one person sits between A and B.

The above statement cannot be satisfied in case II, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b0c7d36ad3fdafa41492a7205d46d11c8e0a46c18bca97cf8ba2bee31bc50ba.png] 

Thus, G sits second to the left of C.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
